Hannah: Quick follow-up re: streaming handoff. I ran a local fuzz that reproed the out-of-order case when primary had non-empty per-req buffer and hedge resumed.
Omar: Thanks. Do you have logs?
Hannah: Pasted two snippets. Primary flushed token 100, then later pushed token 102 after hedge cutover.
Priya: Given we can't change client protocol, I support the lease/handoff model. One thought: to reduce latency we can prefetch KV cache state for the incoming conn and warm TLS to reduce swap time.
Omar: Also limit per-req buffered tokens to 8KB by default; larger responses won't be affected.
Priya: Edge-bot: note added: "swap_telemetry" metric and default route config: swap_mode=atomic, grace_ms=50, per_req_buffer_bytes=8192.
edge-bot: Config noted. Use infra RFC for persistent store changes.
Hannah: I'll add fuzz tests to simulate swap timeout and crash to ensure no duplicate tokens.
Omar: thanks.
Priya: ack.
